name: Air Jordan 12 Retro 'University Gold'
story_html: The Air Jordan 12 Retro ‘University Gold’ features a simple two-tone color scheme that recalls the ‘Away’ PE that Gary Payton during the ’03 to ’04 NBA season – the only stretch in his lengthy career with the Los Angeles Lakers. The retro mid-stop sports a black tumbled leather upper with signature stitch detailing, contrasted by a University Gold finish on the textured forefoot overlays, rubber outsole and branding elements.
